== Notes ==
* Fragility deals no damage upon reapplying a condition.
** It's best to keep conditions on the target ''almost'' non-stop, letting conditions expire and directly afterwards re-apply the condition again.
* [[Shockwave]] and [[Virulence]] can apply three conditions in one skill.
* Synergizes well with [[Avatar of Balthazar]] and [[Reap Impurities]] in dealing large amounts of damage over a short period of time.
* With enough conditions, [[Epidemic]], [[Crystal Wave]] or [[Hypochondria]] can cause a massive [[AoE]] [[spike]].
